notes.bug_found: sheetPath called cx.beginPath() and was used inside an evenodd clip built on cx.rect(0,0,W,H), which wiped the outer rect and drew four slides' casts INSIDE their own sheets where the sheet fill then hid them. Moved those four to static attributes. json.dumps needs separators=(',',':'); (',',' ') silently writes a space where the key separator belongs.

notes.pdf: shrink_pdfs.py DECLINED this deck's PDF: every candidate image fell below the 42 dB PSNR floor (35.9 to 40.1 dB), because the art is high frequency spangle, stipple and grain that does not survive a 192 to 144 DPI resample. The routine says a declined shrink is the correct outcome and there is no flag to force past it, so carousel.pdf ships at 37.09 MB and the Gmail draft says so.
